name: releaseguard
description: ReleaseGuard — Enterprise DevOps Intelligence, Release Risk Management & SRE Control Plane

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@releaseguard/shared && npm run build --workspace=@releaseguard/engine && npm run build --workspace=@releaseguard/api && npm run build --workspace=@releaseguard/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@releaseguard/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@releaseguard/engine && npm run typecheck --workspace=@releaseguard/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@releaseguard/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@releaseguard/engine && npm run test --workspace=@releaseguard/api
